name: Mapa de Varianza Local
description: Analiza the spatial distribución of local intensity varianza. AI images tend to have more uniform varianza distribucións a través de the image.
mechanism: Computes varianza in local blocks and analiza distribución. AI images show less natural variation en textoure complexity.
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 16x16, Metric: coeficiente of variation
useCase: Detección de patrones de varianza uniformes en contenido generado por IA

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2009). Using Noise Inconsistencies for Blind Image Forensics. Image and Vision Computing.
Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries in Color Filter Array Interpolated Images. IEEE TSP.
Pan, X. et al. (2011). Region Duplication Detection Using Image Feature Matching. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Simple and intuitive noise characterization
• Reveals spatial noise inconsistencias
• Fast sliding-window computation
• Effective for detecting spliced regions
• Complementary to frequency-domain noise análisis
limitations:
• Cannot distinguish noise source types
• Textured regions naturally have high varianza
• Window size selection affects spatial resolución
• Sensitive to image content edges and textures
• Post-processing homogenizes varianza patrones
